tested_scope: One deterministic local non-Python Node.js probe over exactly one raw JSON object: {"dup":1,"dup":2,"é":3,"é":4}. Ordinary JSON.parse was compared with a raw-text token-level key scan in the same runtime. No public source, network compute, retry, second leaf, or broader parser was tested.
inference_limited_to_tested_scope: For this exact payload and runtime, ordinary object materialization loses the first exact duplicate-key occurrence, while a pre-materialization raw-token scan preserves both exact duplicate occurrences and can also expose that two distinct raw key spellings normalize to the same NFC string. Therefore a deterministic pre-parse collision guard can detect these two ambiguity classes before ordinary object reconstruction for this tested shape.
scope_guard: No claim is made about arbitrary JSON grammars, escaped-key edge cases, other runtimes, streaming parsers, nested structures, performance, or standards compliance of the minimal token scan. The result is a narrow mechanism probe, not global Phase-1 acceptance.
